justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ThreadUtils.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ThreadUtilsTest.java. The target is a private static nested class with only a private constructor and two trivial test methods, both returning true for Thread and ThreadGroup; it has no fields, no branching, and a single responsibility as the deprecated always-true predicate constant. The test file only verifies this constant’s behavior, which supports that it is a small helper rather than an under-decomposed class.
